overview: This single-page file consists of a “List of Papers” sheet for State Department file 894A.5041, concerning labor conditions in Formosa (Taiwan), particularly working hours and wages. It records an item from Ketcham at Tamsui dated January 23 and points to related file references concerning reports on current wages in Taiwan.

people.name: Ketcham
people.role: Reporting official at Tamsui; specific position not stated

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning wages in Taiwan
subfiles.about: An index sheet records a January 23 item from Ketcham at Tamsui and cites related reports on current wages in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies the file as 894A.5041 and lists sub-number 2 as originating from Tamsui through Ketcham on January 23. Its note refers to other file entries containing reports regarding current wages in Taiwan. No substantive report or correspondence is included on this page.

interest: Although it contains no substantive labor report, this filing sheet is useful for reconstructing the documentary trail surrounding official inquiries into Taiwanese wages. Its cross-references may help historians locate related reports and trace how the State Department organized information on labor and economic conditions in Japanese-ruled Taiwan.
